brief: @buildthis.bisks.net can you build a site that takes a location as input, then generates a real, honest, correct land acknowledgement for it? Not a joke site- a lot of folks will need to use this
note: Built landack: it finds the place, sends you to Indigenous-run sources to verify the nations (no key, so no auto-lookup, on purpose), then writes the statement from only what you confirmed. #NaNoFoMo
